items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I think I had gone to see him with Don Redman.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. I worked in Roseland in '34. Benny Carter had his band across the street -- I can't remember the place -- and a very good band. Rex Stewart had a band over at the same place. Redman had that band at a place call the Congress.
